bagPolicy.summary: Save Mart Center allows one clear bag up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches, or a small clutch up to 4.5 x 6.5 x 2 inches that does not have to be clear.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
Small clutches up to 4.5 x 6.5 x 2 inches, clear or not
Handheld signs and banners up to 2 x 3 feet, with no wood or metal supports
prohibited: Bags that are not clear, apart from a small clutch
Cans, bottles and containers of any kind, including coolers and Hydro Flasks
Cameras with professional or detachable lenses, and flash
Lighters, vapes and all tobacco products
bagPolicy.note: There are no lockers or storage areas, so a bag that does not pass has to go back to your car. Guests who leave the building during an event are not let back in.

parking.note: Save Mart Center offers parking in the North lots and additional parking on Fresno State Campus. Standard vehicle parking is $30 for concerts and non-athletic events, while Fresno State men's basketball games charge $10. Parking fees are subject to change.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Save Mart Center. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Save Mart Center varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is on all levels and at all price levels, with up to three companion seats per accessible seat. For accessible seating information, call 559-278-3400. On show day, the Guest Services Desk in the northwest corner of the main concourse can help with relocations.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: If you exit the building during an event, you won't be let back in.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The Box Office is open Monday to Friday, 12 noon to 5pm, and on event days from 10am until one hour after the event starts. It closes on weekday federal holidays unless there is an event, and hours can change.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Arena doors open at least one hour before the event.
